author: dmaretskyi
body:
i dont think we need to append all intemittent updates, only the combined final state.

so I'd store a single state field -- the latest json state of the feed.

then a set of versions -- that we can compare according to the feed semantics:

- the version of the block that came back from feed store
- whether the current state is dirty and hasn't been appended
- if the current state is dirty and has been appended, what was the version it was appended at, so we know whether to retain local state or remote state when we get another update from the feed
- the version of latest block we got from feed service


lifecycle

Obj.change -> dirty local -> appended -> roundtripped (came back from service) 

after the local state roundtripped, all future blocks should update state, before that we prefer local dirty state
